t: You're looking at a statue of Béla Bartók, the Hungarian composer and pianist, who lived from 1881 to 1945. It was made by Imre Varga, a Hungarian sculptor, painter, designer and graphic artist. Varga was regarded as one of Hungary's most important living artists, and has been called one of the most skilled sculptors in the country. So here, a Hungarian sculptor honours a great Hungarian musician, in the middle of London.
